symptom: Additional overhead layout rendered with shot camera despite assigning layout camera.
root_cause: Timeline camera marker evaluation overrides active camera during frame/render evaluation.
fix: Temporarily clear marker camera bindings, set layout camera, render, restore bindings and shot camera. Opened resulting connected three-space overview.
prevention: For extra diagnostic views, suspend camera marker bindings during render and restore them afterwards. Inspect actual render; camera assignment alone is insufficient.
